title: GateRulesDeclarationMetadata
description: Parameter artifact for `mechanical-ruleset` step type (spec §2.1). A declarative, ordered rule list referenced by CID from a gate-process-declaration. The ordered rule evaluation is first-match-wins against the step's GateContext inputs. Example: the 7-valence discernment ruleset.

version.description: Semantic version of this rule set.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this rule set classifies.

appliesToEventType.description: Which RelationalImpactEvent variant this rule set reasons over.

outputShape.description: JSON schema $ref or shape descriptor for the rule-set's output (e.g., StoryPointTag shape).

rules.description: Ordered rule list. First match wins. Last rule typically matches steady-state (no-mint).

when.description: Declarative match expression over input keys. Non-Turing-complete; inspectable by elohim before execution.

oneOf.description: Structured outcome object (e.g., {valence, magnitude, evidenceType}) to emit when the rule matches.
Null outcome = 'do not mint / no judgment to record' (steady-state).

outcome.description: Outcome returned by this rule on match. Null means silence (baseline absence).

rationale.description: Human-readable justification. Carried into ConstitutionalReasoning when the rule fires.
